statements.impact_statement: The advisory: minimatch before 11.0.1 expands attacker-controlled **/.. segments in firstPhasePreProcess() and compares them pairwise in secondPhasePreProcess(), run at optimizationLevel 2 or higher. Those functions and the optimizationLevel option arrived with the minimatch 7+ rewrite. Verified 2026-11-02 on the npm tarball minimatch-5.1.8.tgz (sha256 3effb35e05b4291721c5a37775dfcf9350cf7a031def3f7b674ecc638219cd4a): grep -c 'firstPhasePreProcess\|optimizationLevel' returned 0 for package/minimatch.js and package/lib/path.js, the only JavaScript files it ships. 5.1.8 is the glob-scoped copy under pm2's glob 8, which needs minimatch ^5.
